Aisha (Support): Escalating to CS P1 — SynthMart trial account ingest is returning 429s during bulk embed import since 09:17 UTC. Onboarding validation failing, demo tomorrow AM.
Liam (CSM): Ack. Is this blocking their scheduled walkthrough?
Aisha (Support): QA can't complete dataset import so yes, walkthrough at risk.
Raf (CS Ops): Paste a log snippet please.
Aisha (Support): ```
2026-05-10T09:16:58Z ERROR ingest tenant=synthmart status=429 reason=quota_exhausted concurrent=48
2026-05-10T09:17:05Z ERROR ingest tenant=synthmart status=429 reason=burst_window exceeded
```
Nina (SRE): I see a short burst of parallel writes + retry loops. Can open a temporary quota increase on their dedicated shard and add 502 backoff headers to slow retries.
Liam (CSM): Do the bump if it reduces customer risk. Also need a 1-paragraph status to send to the customer by 11:00 local.
Raf (CS Ops): Comms plan: apology, temporary mitigation, ask to pause retries, offer 15m pre-demo check, promise post-mortem within 24h. Who will draft?
Aisha (Support): Draft: "Hi Priyanka — quick update: we observed transient rate limits that caused your embed import to fail. We have applied a temporary quota increase and are monitoring. To help stabilize, please pause automated retries for 60 minutes. We will prioritize your onboarding and propose a short 15-minute pre-demo check; we will confirm timing within the hour. Apologies for the disruption — Aisha, Support (Redwood)."
Liam (CSM): Nice. Add sentence: "We have placed this account on renewal-watch and a Solutions Engineer will do a post-demo enablement."
Aisha (Support): Updated draft includes renewal-watch line.
Nina (SRE): Applied +35% quota to redwood-ded-11 for synthmart and enabled short backpressure headers. Error rate dropped in last 30s. Creating INC-2026-044-11 and assigning to me.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-044-11 created and assigned to Nina.
Raf (CS Ops): Action items: Liam send status by 10:50 local, Nina run post-incident diffs and capture KV cache churn, Aisha update KB with retry guidance, CS Ops to tag the account renewal-watch and notify finance for potential seat uplift discussion.
Liam (CSM): Sending now. Pasting for review: "Hi Priyanka — we saw transient rate limits that briefly impacted your embed import. We've increased your quota temporarily and are monitoring; errors have subsided. Please pause automated retries for 60 minutes while we stabilize. We're prioritizing your onboarding and will confirm a 15-minute pre-demo check within the hour. We'll follow up with a full post-mortem within 24 hours. — Liam, CSM (Redwood)"
Aisha (Support): LGTM :thumbsup:
Nina (SRE): Monitoring continues. If 429s return I will escalate to runtime lead and consider traffic shaping.
Raf (CS Ops): I'll add renewal-watch to the account doc and loop SE + Finance. Liam, please offer SE time after the demo.
Liam (CSM): Call scheduled: pre-demo check tentative — will confirm. Marking this as CS-priority. Thanks team.
Aisha (Support): Closing initial escalation; will reopen if customer reports further failures."
